wish: someone should make an app that plays a tone and shows if I hit it when singing
spec:
Plays a target note (C2 to C6) and listens through the microphone to show how many cents sharp or flat you are, live.
Pick a note with - / + or New note, tap Play to hear it, tap Sing and hold the note; within 20 cents for half a second counts as a hit.
Any octave counts as the same note; it does not record or upload audio, and it cannot score with the microphone blocked.
notes: Pitch detection uses the microphone via getUserMedia, requested on tap only; audio stays on the device. Mic input is ignored while the reference tone plays.
